name: When are plumbing and electrical lines installed during addition framing?

mainEntity.name: When are plumbing and electrical lines installed during addition framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing and electrical rough-ins take place immediately after framing is finished and inspected, but before insulation and drywall are hung. Framers must complete all studs, plates, and headers so plumbers and electricians can bore holes and run pipes, wires, and conduit through the framing without compromising structural integrity. Having your general contractor oversee framing while coordinating licensed sub-trades ensures that mechanical runs do not conflict with load-bearing studs or header placements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sub-trades install electrical wiring and plumbing pipes immediately after framing is complete and structurally inspected, prior to insulation and drywall installation.
